description: LLM-optimized knowledge base for the Openapi® API marketplace: platform guide (OAuth v2, billing, sandbox), API catalog, per-service endpoints and OpenAPI 3 specs.
rules: Always read platform-guide.md together with any service page: authentication, scopes, billing and async patterns are shared by every service.
Get tokens from the OAuth v2 API (oauthv2); the old OAuth v1 API is deprecated.
For tests use the sandbox environment: free requests (enable "sandbox credit" in the console first), illustrative and possibly incomplete responses.
